gui.gamblingitems.rules.upgrader: Put one priced item in, choose the item you are playing for, and pull. The chance shown is the one the server draws on: the dearer the target, the smaller it is. A win gives the chosen item, a loss takes what was staked. The draw happens once, on the server.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.crash: Everyone bets in the same round, in any priced items. The multiplier climbs from 1.00x and the flight ends at a secret point drawn before the round. Cash out before it ends and you are paid your bet times the multiplier; wait too long and the bet is lost. The items staked come back on a win, the profit is paid in change. Cheating: with a Rigged Watch on you and a bet placed, a red button makes the watch vibrate just before the crash. Spotted, the bet is lost.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.trade_up: Hand over the required number of items of similar value. The machine gives back one item drawn from a table built on what was put in, worth more or less than it. The odds and the rewards are printed in the window before you commit.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.case_opening: A case is opened with the key of its rarity, found on mobs. Each reward has a weight, shown as the chance of each line. The draw is made on the server once the case is opened; the reel only replays it.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.roulette: Prepare your chips, then click an area of the felt to put them there. A number pays 36 times the bet, a dozen or a column 3 times, red, black, odd, even, low and high 2 times. Zero belongs to no even money bet. The wheel only replays the pocket the server has drawn. Cheating: with a Roulette Magnet on you and chips on the table, a red button drags the ball one pocket aside. Spotted, your chips are seized.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.case_battle: Several players join the same lobby and open the same cases at the same time. Each round is drawn for everybody; the best total when the last case is opened takes the whole table. Everything opened is priced from the same catalogue.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.blackjack: Beat the dealer without going over 21. An ace is one or eleven, a court card is ten. The dealer draws to sixteen and stands on seventeen. A win pays the bet twice, a blackjack pays it two and a half times, a push hands back the very items staked. Cheating: with a Marked Card Lens on you, a red button reads the hole card and the next card, once per hand. Spotted, the hand is lost and you are thrown out.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.bingo: Buy a card, then the drum draws numbers everyone shares. Your card marks itself as they come out; the free square in the middle is always marked. The first cards to fill a line share the pot. A card that has been paid for stays with the round until it settles.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.slot_machine: Prepare any priced items as credit and pull the lever. The three reels stop one after the other: three alike pay the line of that symbol, two alike pay 1.4 times the credit, anything else takes it. The items played come back on a win and only the profit is made up in change. Cheating: with a Reel Shim on you, a red button makes your next pull keep the better of two lines. Spotted, the credit is lost.

gui.gamblingitems.rules.prediction_marke: Every question is a YES or NO bet on something a player will or will not do in time. The price of YES is the probability the traders give it: buying YES raises it, buying NO lowers it, and a market maker always quotes a price, even with a single trader. Your whole stake buys shares and you receive a physical ticket: keep it, give it, sell it back before the question closes, or cash it once it is settled. Each winning share pays the value shown in the subtitle. The game settles questions about players by itself. A written question is answered by its creator and can be disputed for a few minutes; an operator then decides. Anyone can open a question with a stake: the creator earns the fees and whatever the market maker did not lose. Betting that you will fail at a question about yourself is allowed, but the gaming commission may seize the winning ticket.
